trivial_zero_s_minus_2.interpretation: s = -2 is a trivial zero (n=1 case of s = -2n)

trivial_zero_s_minus_4.interpretation: s = -4 is a trivial zero (n=2 case of s = -2n)

trivial_zero_pattern_admitted.interpretation: Trivial zeros form a pattern at even negative integers s = -2n for n ≥ 1

odd_negative_rejected.interpretation: s = -1 violates trivial zero constraint s = -2n (parity mismatch)

positive_trivial_zero_rejected.interpretation: Positive s cannot be a trivial zero; constraint s = -2n with n ≥ 1 requires s < 0

non_negative_integer_rejected.interpretation: s = 0 violates trivial zero constraint; must satisfy s = -2n with n ≥ 1

large_n_trivial_zeros.interpretation: Trivial zero pattern extends to arbitrarily large n; s = -2n holds for n=100 → s=-200

functional_equation_pole_zero.interpretation: Trivial zeros arise from sin(πs/2)=0 in functional equation; s=2k with k negative gives negative even integers

sine_factor_zeros.interpretation: Sine factor sin(πs/2) has zeros at s = 2m for all integers m; negative m yields negative even trivial zeros
